nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What major environmental issues are associated with the manufacturing of synthetic chemicals in the pharmaceutical industry?
nodes.answer: The manufacturing of synthetic chemicals generates toxic waste and contributes to high greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green manufacturing methods|Green chemistry practices_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What are some of the challenges faced in the production of synthetic chemicals mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The production of synthetic chemicals is cost- and time-intensive and involves costly and harmful compounds along with extensive purification steps.

nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: Which naturally sourced fine chemicals are mentioned as examples in the text?
nodes.answer: Examples of naturally sourced fine chemicals mentioned include lycopene and ubiquinone.
